# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Gr33nOps/Envryn/security/advisories/new) for suspected vulnerabilities. Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, credentials, vault contents, or other sensitive information.

Include the affected version and platform, the smallest reproducible example you can safely provide, the security impact, and any suggested mitigation. Reports will be acknowledged as soon as practical and coordinated privately until a fix is available.

## Supported versions

Envryn is currently beta software. Security fixes target the newest beta release; users should update to the latest release because older beta versions do not receive separate backports.

## Scope

Useful reports include cryptographic or key-handling flaws, authentication and pairing bypasses, sync trust failures, secret exposure through storage, logs, clipboard, screen capture or backups, unsafe Tauri capabilities, and release/package integrity problems. General feature requests and non-security crashes belong in ordinary issues.
